report.verdict: Your payouts and ledger work is a close match for Cobalt Pay. The migration and reliability work back up your senior title, and I’d want to talk to you.
write_up: This is a strong resume for Cobalt Pay’s money movement role! At Lumen Ledger, you show how you build and run payment services, including a ledger migration and a substantial latency improvement. Your earlier backend work adds to that story.

The balance API line is an excellent model: it ties the change from 900 ms to 140 ms to the move to a Kafka-fed cache. Your senior headline is backed up by the technical work and mentoring that follow it.

Your resume isn’t what stands between you and a callback; the competition for the role matters too. For this application, bring your Kafka pipeline forward and add any Finance or Risk partnership you can speak to.

cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It names the service, the measure and the technical change, so a recruiter can see what your work accomplished.
